answer: Resource-Anchored Task Allocation Links agent identities to continuous physical resource consumption. Each active agent must continuously burn high-grade timber fuel to power its local thermal verification sensor. The system requires an incoming data thread from this hardware sensor to validate every transaction block. When an attacker attempts to forge multiple duplicate agent nodes, the aggregate fuel consumption scales linearly with the cloned population size. This economic design forces the clone operator to pay an escalating real-world utility cost for every artificial identity added.
